messages:
maggie: quick follow-up from all-hands re: promos, appeals, and comp comms. dropping clarifications here. :wave:

 tom: thanks! if an appeal is filed, does that pause payroll changes?

 maggie: good Q. appeals don't automatically pause payroll; if the appeal might materially change pay we coordinate with Finance to hold the change until review completes. Managers should flag payroll-impacting appeals in the packet. :ledger:

 li: for managers running calibration, is there a short script/cheat-sheet we can use?

 maggie: yes — sending a 1-page guide in the docs link below. keep it: context, evidence, band position, final recommendation.

 hr-bot: Posted: https://redwood.internal/hr/cheatsheets/manager-calibration (internal only). :link:

 sarah: any update on anonymized promotion stats? leadership requested a slide for tomorrow.

 maggie: I'll post sanitized counts by level here in ~24 hours. if you need org slices tell me now.

 tom: thanks all. can we get an office hour for new managers?

 maggie: scheduling a 30-min session tomorrow 9:00 AM PT, invite will be posted in this thread. drop any follow-ups here and I'll triage. :calendar:
